lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest crypto heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI said Saturday.
Judge throws out Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter, The Associated Press reports.
Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
